checks.check: Final iPhone pending requests, touch targets, and large text

findings.finding: Repeated taps could schedule multiple bot launches or provider updates.
findings.resolution: Pending state is set before creating a task; actions are disabled and checked at entry. Requests capture their reviewed inputs.

findings.finding: Cached bot approval/run controls and keyboard console submission stayed available offline.
findings.resolution: Execution controls check connection state. Offline keyboard submission preserves the command and explains how to reconnect.

findings.finding: Settings requested another sheet during dismissal.
findings.resolution: Computer switching and diagnostics open from the dismissal completion; navigation is covered on phone and tablet.

findings.finding: Errors could be hidden behind the open menu or full-screen session form.
findings.resolution: Bots, sharing, the Mac hub, and session setup present errors in the visible surface. Rejected requests keep the draft.

findings.finding: Successful run-control responses could clear text edited while the request was pending.
findings.resolution: Answer, steer, launch, and key drafts clear only when the submitted text is still current; provider fields are locked during updates.

findings.finding: Cached provider readiness and an empty provider list could imply a live connection or failed search.
findings.resolution: Provider detail explicitly reports Mac offline, disables mutations, and uses a useful empty state and reconnect guidance.

findings.finding: Some destructive controls had inconsistent disabled feedback and small touch targets.
findings.resolution: Bot controls and key removal use the shared style and 44-point targets. Bot action controls stack at accessibility text sizes.

findings.finding: A cancelled sharing toast task could clear newer feedback.
findings.resolution: Toast lifetime is keyed to its message and cancellation returns without clearing the current notice.

findings.finding: The offline bot notice did not match the shared card shape; previous release archives omitted crash symbols.
findings.resolution: The notice uses the shared rounded shape. This archive generates matching dSYMs and includes matching symbols in the IPA.

scope: Companion iOS only; no App Store submission or new tester invitations
limitations: Physical iPhone/Mac, live Tailscale streaming, and sleep/wake were not exercised in this pass; optional isolated-host and live/expensive tests were skipped.
